from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The specific legal case type or cause of action identified in the text (e.g., '交通肇事罪', '行政非诉执行')")
    relevant_legal_nature: str | None = Field(description="The broader legal nature mentioned in the text that maps to a category (e.g., '危害公共安全罪', '行政给付')")
    evidence_quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the text that supports the classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated extraction from the current document."""
    documents: list[DocumentInfo] = Field(description="List containing the extracted document information")
